title: Blinatumomab Consolidation in Real World
official: Real World Outcomes of Blinatumomab Consolidation in Patients With B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
summary: This will be a multi-center registry for patients with B-ALL. Patient data will be collected both retrospectively and prospectively. The data forms and surveys will be built and managed through REDCap, a secure web application managed by the Clinical \& Translational Science Institute.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\) aged 18 years or older 2) diagnosed with B-ALL on or after December 1st 2022 3) Not received blinatumomab in an interventional clinical trial setting 4) Willing and able to give informed consent (or retrospective data for deceased patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
